title: How a U.K. Official’s Wife Set Off a Debate Over Free Speech and Palestinians
summary_full: Sarah Helm, who is married to Britain’s national security adviser, posted of her support for the author Sally Rooney and a banned pro-Palestinian activist group. A furor ensued.
